Batch: JoeWare ShrFlgs, SNU and SvcUtil publisher source review

Scope.AdFindAcceptance: Excluded from selected acceptance batches; no AdFind action in this review.

Findings: ShrFlgs sets share flags, including Access-Based Enumeration and client-caching flags; page version 1.00.01 dated 2005-02-19.
Requires at least Power User, Server Operator or Administrator; historical platforms are Windows 2000, Server 2003 and XP; source code unavailable.
Publisher warns some OS versions silently ignore unsupported flags and recommends viewing settings after updates.

Sources.Finding: Usage supports read-only display, per-share changes and all-share changes, with /forreal on mutation examples; ABE updates can target all disk shares. No share was queried or changed.

Findings: SNU connects to or disconnects from a network share using the current security context and has no userid/password parameters; page version 1.00.00 dated 2001-11-04.
Historical platforms end at XP; source code unavailable.

Sources.Finding: Usage accepts a server/share path with /ADD or /DEL. No network share was contacted.

Findings: SvcUtil views service information and can stop/start/pause/continue services; page version 2.04.00 dated 2005-06-12.
Publisher notes it requests only permissions needed for the selected action and can work with delegated service ACLs; historical platform claims end at XP and source code is unavailable.
